name: web
description: Python MCP web tools server: web_search (provider abstraction over Tavily/Brave/DuckDuckGo/Exa) and web_extract (readable markdown extraction from a URL, capped inline with spill-to-file). API keys are referenced from the secrets store by name ($secret:NAME) and are never committed.

config_schema.label: Default provider
config_schema.description: Default search provider when a call omits 'provider': tavily | brave | ddg | exa

config_schema.label: Tavily API key
config_schema.description: Tavily API key. Reference the secret by name: set to $secret:TAVILY_API_KEY

config_schema.label: Brave Search API key
config_schema.description: Brave Search API key. Reference the secret by name: set to $secret:BRAVE_API_KEY

config_schema.label: Exa API key
config_schema.description: Exa API key. Reference the secret by name: set to $secret:EXA_API_KEY

config_schema.label: web_extract spill directory
config_schema.description: Directory where web_extract spills full extractions that exceed the inline cap. Set to a host-visible path under the deployment data dir (e.g. /opt/omni/data/web_extract). Empty = system temp dir.
